purpose: Test whether the price-relevant predictive component improves with sequence information/model family and persists across three genuinely unseen regimes, without ranking by flow IC alone.
targets_scaler: One official sklearn StandardScaler per fold/horizon, fitted only on identical mature fitting endpoint IDs; all families share exact parameters and inverse original units before scoring.
information_set: Same closed past256x68 sequence plus six closed 60m Spot state features for all families. Tabular uses original last/mean/population-std summary; TCN uses original sequence and same state in its new small prediction head.
normalization: Reuse original unique fitting raw-row FoldNormalizer for the same 68 features; same train-only endpoint StandardScaler for six state features. No fitting on validation/test. Tabular summaries computed after common raw normalization, no additional model-specific pipeline.

tcn.new_head_only: small endpoint representation plus same state6 to six outputs
tcn.training: same AdamW/batch16/accumulation4/clip1/max10epochs/patience3/lr0.001/weight_decay0.0001/CPU2threads as original trainer; shape-aware glue only
tcn.selection: minimum six-primary standardized validation MSE, never test return

common_endpoint_selection: Identical endpoint IDs across all families and both horizons, exact past-window QA/state availability, observed synchronized labels at 5/15m; future-valid label conditioning must be explicit and is not an online inference filter.
split_maturity: All fitting labels mature before validation_start minus embargo; all validation labels before test_start minus embargo; no OOS labels read to change recipe.
source_selection: Explicit source_view daily-first ShardSpec logical view, completed monthly official CHECKSUM/EOF/CRC/independent QA and actual Parquet SHA only; no gap skipping, no locked or 180-day-start gate.

economics.reuse: unchanged quant.research_fast.evaluation.economics through horizon price validation adapter
economics.policy: long/flat, one position per symbol, nonoverlapping same-symbol fixed horizon holds

required_diagnostics: predicted-flow component to same-symbol return relevance
residual and prediction correlations across families
true future-flow residual correlation only as nontradable diagnostic
comparison_periods: Per-fold 7 days, plus chronological disjoint-period aggregate explicitly not a continuous long-term account; short annualized proxy is never validated long-term APR.
pruning: No family decision after A/B alone. After all three plus residual/diversity, retain at most three promising recipe directions using net economics and robustness; no positive candidates implies zero candidates, not fabricated top-three. Pause recipes with concrete reopen conditions, preserve capability.

budget.frontier_allocation: At least 20 percent of research effort reserved for sequence information and price-relevance exploration; no new execution framework

config_changes_after_first_unseen_result: Prohibited except documented correctness blockers; preserve old evidence and independently version repair/reproduction.
